schema.title: Response List Published Courses Courses Get

get.description:
Lesson detail, gated by ownership. Admins see any lesson; everyone else
must own the course. Returns 404 (not 403) for a non-existent course/lesson
so we don't leak which slugs exist.
Courses the current user owns (has an entitlement for).

schema.title: Response My Courses Me Courses Get

get.description:
One of the user's own orders, so the checkout return page can tell a
confirmed payment from a pending or failed one. Someone else's order is a
404, so ids can't be probed.

post.description:
Manually grant a user access to a course. Idempotent — re-granting an
existing entitlement returns it rather than erroring.

delete.description:
Take a course away: a manual grant, or access kept after a refund. The
purchase history is left as it is.

get.description: The full tree including video ids, which no public route exposes.

patch.description:
Setting kinescope_video_id here links a video that already exists in
Kinescope. Uploading a new one goes through /admin/lessons/{id}/video.

post.description:
Find R2 files no material points at, and delete them only if apply=true.

A dry run by default, so an admin page can show what would go before
anything does.

get.description: Accounts whose email contains `email`, ignoring case, newest first.
An account with every course it owns and every payment it attempted.

Transaction history, newest first. Filter by part of the buyer's email,
by course, or by status; pending rows are abandoned checkouts.

post.description:
Record a refund made in FreedomPay's merchant cabinet. This sends no
money: it marks the purchase refunded and, if asked, takes the course away.

get.description:
Where the lesson's video stands. A pending upload is checked with
Kinescope and swapped in if processing has finished.

CheckoutResponse.title: CheckoutResponse
CheckoutResponse.description: What the frontend needs to send the buyer to FreedomPay's hosted page.

DrmAuthRequest.title: DrmAuthRequest
DrmAuthRequest.description:
Kinescope's playback check. Fields are optional so a malformed body
answers 400 on our terms rather than FastAPI's 422.

DrmTokenResponse.title: DrmTokenResponse
DrmTokenResponse.description:
Everything the player needs. The video id has been withheld from every
catalog response up to this point — owning the course is what releases it.

KinescopeWebhook.title: KinescopeWebhook
KinescopeWebhook.description:
Kinescope's status notification. Only the video id is used, to pick which
lesson to re-check; the status itself is read back from the API.

LessonAdmin.title: LessonAdmin
LessonAdmin.description:
Unlike LessonPublic and LessonDetail, this one does show the video id —
the author is the one person who needs to see what's attached.

LessonDetail.title: LessonDetail
LessonDetail.description:
Returned only to a user who owns the course (or an admin). Still no raw
kinescope id — playback goes through the DRM token endpoint (Day 8). This
just confirms access and whether a video is attached.

MaterialDownload.title: MaterialDownload
MaterialDownload.description:
A short-lived link. Deliberately not stored anywhere — ask again when it
expires rather than caching it.

MaterialPublic.title: MaterialPublic
MaterialPublic.description:
What a material is called, never where it's stored. The file itself comes
from /materials/{id}/download, which checks ownership.

MaterialUpdate.title: MaterialUpdate
MaterialUpdate.description:
Title and type only.

storage_key and the parent are fixed at creation: repointing a row would
strand the uploaded object, and moving a material to another course would
quietly hand it to a different set of owners.

MaterialUploadRequest.title: MaterialUploadRequest
MaterialUploadRequest.description: Only the filename — the server picks where the bytes actually land.

MyPurchase.title: MyPurchase
MyPurchase.description:
A buyer's own order, for the page FreedomPay sends them back to. The
redirect proves nothing; this is what the payment callback recorded.

RefundRequest.title: RefundRequest
RefundRequest.description: A refund already made in FreedomPay's merchant cabinet.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description:
What an admin can change on an account. The email stays its owner's, and
any other field sent is a 422 rather than silently ignored.

VideoUploadTarget.title: VideoUploadTarget
VideoUploadTarget.description: Give `endpoint` to tus-js-client. It takes no token.
